filo tags
filo tags rename OLD NEW

  Lists every tag in use with how many files have it (files deleted by filo do
  not count), and how many files have a tag and how many none.

  tags rename gives every file that has OLD the tag NEW instead, spelled as
  typed: it fixes a typo in a key or a value, or changes only the case
  (sender:british gas to sender:British Gas). With key: for both (sendr:
  sender:) it renames the key of every value. A file that has both keeps one.
